		Dataset Description
	

This repository provides two English‐only prompt collections designed to evaluate text‑to‑image models on their ability to depict object absence (empty or negated states):

Object State Bench  

Size: 200 prompts  
Origin: 100 prompts from a fully‑automatic synthetic pipeline; 100 prompts authored by human annotators.  
Focus: Common objects explicitly in empty or absent… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tianle/Object-State-Bench.
evaluation_method: human_eval (judgments of whether generated images correctly depict object absence)
reputation: A small Hugging Face prompt benchmark used by researchers studying text-to-image negation, with modest community adoption.
